**NiltiM INSURANCE REGULATORY AND ir.lai DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA** ## ## # IRDAI (REGISTRATION OF CORPORATE AGENTS) REGULATIONS, 2015 READ WITH SEC 42E OF THE INSURANE ACT 1938. M/s R K Live-well Assurance Private Limited (hereinafter referred to as 'the corporate agent') having its registered office at Plot No. 81 , Village Khichripur, New Delhi, Delhi- Development Authority of India (hereinafter referred to as 'the Authority') to act as a Corporate Agent (LI FE) vide Certificate of Registration No. CA0102 on 23rd March, 2016 pursuant to the provisions of IRDAI (Registration of Corporate Agents) Regulations, 2015 (hereinafter referred to as 'Corporate Agent Regulations') and the Certificate of Registration is valid up to 31st March, 2019. It has come to the notice of the Authority that the Registrar of Companies (hereinafter ' Subsection (5) of Section 248 of Companies Act, 2013 vide Notice No- ROC/ DEL/ 248 (5)/ STK-7 / 2879 has dissolved and struck off the company of the corporate agent from ffiffiT <1°~i'l"r.wt ~ -
**ffiffiT ffiiT <1°~i'l"r.wt** ~ - 500 **004 'llffif** sharam Bhavan 3rd Floor Basheer derabad - 500 004. India. 3.The Authority, vide e-mail dated 22.08.2017 communicated this observation to SBI Life from the insurance company regarding solicitation of insurance business by the corporate agent. Insurance Company that has tied-up with the corporate agent and clarification was sought confirmed that they have issued a Suspension Letter dated 31.08.2017 after taking cognizance of the 'Strike-off status' of the corporate agent company by ROC, and have advis ed the corporate agent not solicit any life insurance business for the insurance company until further instructions are provided. 4. SBI Life Insurance Company reverted to the Authority via email dated 05.09.2017 and > inform the Authority in writing immediately if there is any material change in the information already submitted to the Authority subject to which certificate of registration has been granted to the corporate agent. The ROC has struck off the name of the company from their register. The corporate status of the entity is no more in existence > which is a material change in the information submitted by the agent at the time of registration. The corporate agent has failed to inform in writing about the 'Strike-off Status of their company with ROC, thereby violated Regulation 14(iii) of the Regulation. 5. As per Regulation 14 (iii) of the Corporate Agent Regulations, Corporate agent has to has to disclose to the Authority about any proceedings initiated against them by other regulatory or Government bodies within a period of 30 days. The corporate agent was in receipt of Notice from Office of Registrar of Companies in the month of March 2017. No communication was received from the corporate agent in this regard and thereby violated Regulation 22(3) of the Regulation. 6. Further as per Regulation 22 (3) of the Corporate Agent Regulations, Corporate agent ~ - 7.The Authority has observed that th e corporate agent has failed to comply with the condition subject to which the registration had been granted. Considering that the t > company's name has been 'struck-off from the list of companies of ROC, the Authority exercising the power under Regulation 28 Schedule V, clause Ill (ii) of the corporate agent > regulations which specify cancellation or suspension of registration of a corporate agent > without notice, hereby suspend the certificate of registration of the corporate agent forthwith. The corporate agent shall cease to carry on the business for the period during which the suspension subsists. before the Securities Appellate Tribunal, as per provisions stipulated under Section 11 0 of Insurance Act, 1938. 8 Further, if the Applicant is not satisfied with this order, an appeal may be preferred Date :17.10.2017 Place: Hyderabad (Nllesh Sathe) Member (Life) ~
